ReconciliationIdentification.name: Reconciliation Identification
ReconciliationIdentification.definition: Identifier of a host reconciliation period: acquirer for a payment or server for loyalty.

SaleReconciliationIdentification.name: Sale Reconciliation Identification
SaleReconciliationIdentification.definition: Identifier of a reconciliation period on the sale system.

Brand.name: Brand
Brand.definition: Brand of payment card or loyalty system.

POIIdentification.name: POI Identification
POIIdentification.definition: Identifier of the POI system performing a reconciliation.

SaleIdentification.name: Sale Identification
SaleIdentification.definition: Identification of the sale terminal (electronic cash register or point of sale terminal) or the sale system.

CashierIdentification.name: Cashier Identification
CashierIdentification.definition: Identification of the cashier who carried out the transactions.

ShiftNumber.name: Shift Number
ShiftNumber.definition: Identifies the shift of the cashier.

SponsoredMerchant.name: Sponsored Merchant
SponsoredMerchant.definition: Merchant using the payment services of a payment facilitator, acting as a card acceptor.

TransactionTotal.name: Transaction Total
TransactionTotal.definition: Payment Transaction totals during the reconciliation period, for a certain type of transaction.

LoyaltyTransactionTotal.name: Loyalty Transaction Total
LoyaltyTransactionTotal.definition: Loyalty Transaction totals during the reconciliation period, for a certain type of transaction.
